end.summary:
Practised expanding base-10 numbers using place values and powers of 10.
Neel worked with 10² = 100 and 10³ = 1,000.
They identified zero as a placeholder in expanded form.
Neel continued to mix up 5,030 and 530; this was not corrected by the last turn.
Teach-back was not passed; 2 of 4 attempts were unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Neel practised reading place values, writing expanded forms with powers of 10, and understanding that 10² means 10 × 10 and 10³ means 10 × 10 × 10. They connected 10² with 100 and 10³ with 1,000, and used the zero term in one expanded form after seeing the board. They still mixed up 5,030 and 530 at the end, so this needs more practice. At home, use place-value cards or a drawing to compare 5,030 and 530 and show that the zero keeps the 5 in the thousands place.

नहीं... पाँच हज़ार और पाँच सौ बराबर कैसे होंगे? लेकिन ज़ीरो तो वहाँ कुछ नहीं है ना, तो फ़र्क क्यों पड़ता है?

Bilkul, paanch hazaar aur paanch sau barabar nahi hain. Zero ka matlab us jagah par koi ginti nahi, par woh jagah khaali rakhne ka nishaan hai. Jaise kursiyon ki line mein ek kursi khaali ho, use hata dein to baaki logon ki jagah badal jaati hai. 5,030 mein sau ki jagah par kya hai?
